title: Bruno made our Costa Brava trip exceptional!
text:

Bruno was a phenomenal guide who went above and beyond in every way possible. He was professional, incredibly knowledgeable, and perfectly accommodated our preferences.

title: An Unforgettable Introduction to the Costa Brava with Bruno
text:

title: Magical tours of Barcelona, Montserrat, and Cadaques with Bruno De Angelis.
text: There is no better way to see Barcelona, Montserrat, and Costa Brave (especially Cadaqués) than with Bruno De Angelis. His tours are magical and were the highlight of our visit to Spain. His knowledge of the history of these areas is incredible.  He made us feel like family and we feel the same now about him. I would recommend taking a tour with Bruno  anytime, he is truly one of a kind.
